exposure: high Apgar score at one minute
cohort: 46 newborns with birth fractures and 223 randomly selected newborns without fractures
finding: Large for gestational age, meconium stain, instrumented delivery, and nurse attendant were associated with an increased risk of birth fracture, while a high Apgar score at one minute and cesarean delivery were associated with a decreased risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a decreased risk of birth fracture.
birth_weight: Babies with a fracture had significantly higher birthweight compared to those without
